<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-2413-47-24" status="unreviewed">
                  <milestone n="rtags kyi ngo bo la ltos nas ma grub pa" unit="section"/>gnyis pa rtags kyi ngo bo
               <lb n="45a7"/>la ltos nas ma grub pa ni sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa la don dam myi byas pa rtags su bkod pa lta bu yin te | 'di la <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha 1</rs> na re don dam gyi byas pa shes bya la mi srid pas rtags yang dag ltar snang gang du yang bzhag du med gsung ba mi 'thad de | de ltar na sgra mnyan bya ma yin par dam bcas pa la mnyan byar tshad mas grub pas bsal ba de dam bca' skyon
               <lb n="45a8"/>can skyon med gang du yang bzhig du med par 'gyur | sgra mnyan bya ma yin pa shes bya la med pa'i phyir byas pa la tshogs pa shes bya la mi srid kyang sgra rgyang mtshan gzhi mnyan bya ma yin pa dang tshogs par dam bcas pa la ltos nas dam bcas la bsal bar mtshon |</seg></TEI>
